changelog: Hunger and thirst isolation: RP needs are safely saved upon entering Opulus and perfectly restored upon returning to the normal server.
Cross-framework status synchronization: Opulus survival status is synchronized in real time with the framework HUD, and default VR experiences provide 100% full needs.
In-game Blips & POIs manager: admins can create, edit, duplicate and delete custom map blips and 3D in-game markers for any Opulus experience with 3D raycast placement and live sync.
Zombie corpse looting: players can search dead zombies with animations, progress bar, damage/movement cancellation, and 100% customizable loot tables in config.lua.
Weapons rebuilt: no more ammo taken from the inventory when shooting, the weapon stays in hand when empty, reload with R using the GTA animation.
Polyzone editor freecam: fly around to place vertices quickly (F toggles it).
Reload now uses the native GTA reload animation instead of a progress bar.
Polyzones: draw polygon zones in game with safe zones, zombie spawn/damage/speed multipliers, loot and survival effects, dangerous areas and no-PvP.
Admin edit mode: edit Opulus points from inside the Opulus world (solo or live instance), then return to your exact spot.
Your Opulus position is saved with your inventory; manual reload on R and no more infinite ammo; you are revived on exit if you died in VR.
The survival HUD now sits on the right side of the screen.
Fixed a startup error when the instance script is older than 2.7.0 (missing setEntityInstance export).

Loot window for containers, bags and dropped piles, real drag & drop in the VR inventory, weapons usable in VR, no more time/weather flicker, zombie spawn fix and a friendlier /conf_acn_opulus (requires acn_bridge 2.16.1+ and acn_weathertime 13.1.2+).

Opulus Apocalypse: open-world zombie survival with AI zombies, bosses, separate VR inventory, loot, vehicles with fuel, day/night, survival HUD, leaderboard and a full in-game /conf_acn_opulus (requires oxmysql and acn_bridge 2.16.0+).
After the boot screen you now pick your game in a full-screen selection menu (Opulus Apocalypse available, more coming soon).
All map blips are now hidden while you are inside Opulus and come back when you leave.
First release of Opulus VR: put on the headset and explore Los Santos in a private instance.
Your character stays visible in the real world while you are inside.
Admin menu /conf_acn_opulus to place the demo spawn point in game.
